subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: We live in environment (a) ______ contains many components. (b) ______ differences between the urban and rural life are gradually narrowing due to modern educational and medical facilities. (c) ______ rural and urban people do not live in isolation. With the help of (d) ______ communication system, the urban people can enjoy a greater bond with their communication network. (e) ______ rural life is deprived of modern facilities whereas urban life is considered an enjoyable one.
guide_solution: Connectors: (a) but (b) besides (c) whereas/on the other hand (d) moreover (e) thus
